subject: Mutual Action Plan & Launch Governance — Draft schedule and responsibility roster
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Evan Holt <evan.holt@clearbay.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@clearbay.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan & Launch Governance — Draft schedule and responsibility roster

Evan/Priya,

Great to meet yesterday — appreciate the clarity on ClearBay's priorities for the pilot. I pulled together a lean Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and a compact ownership roster to keep the first 90 days tight and measurable. Attaching the spreadsheet and a one-page RACI.

Key items in the attached draft: 
- Kickoff & data handoff target: Sep 20–24 (ClearBay to share sample dataset and schema)
- Integration sprint (API auth + qps tuning): 2 weeks after data handoff
- Validation window (perf, cost, quality): 3 weeks
- Go/no-go checkpoint with mutual acceptance criteria on token cost and latency SLA

Immediate asks for ClearBay:
1) Confirm the primary technical contact for data exchange (we have Evan listed).
2) Verify the preferred go/no-go evaluation metric (latency P95 + qualitative acceptance on 500 test prompts).

Internal owners: 
- Account lead / overall timeline: Jonas Weber
- Implementation lead / sprints: Marissa Cole
- Model & runtime tuning: Mina Haddad
- Cutover & bridge day: Ben Carter

Attachments: ClearBay_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), Launch_RACI_v1.pdf (one-pager)

If Sep 20 window looks tight for you, suggest we move data handoff to Sep 27 and compress integration to a single intensive week — open to your preference.

Thanks,
Jonas
--
Jonas Weber
Senior Director, Growth — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

[Attachment: ClearBay_MAP_v1.xlsx] [Attachment: Launch_RACI_v1.pdf]

From: Evan Holt <evan.holt@clearbay.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@clearbay.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & Launch Governance — Draft schedule and responsibility roster

Jonas — thanks for the quick turn. The draft looks sensible. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Primary technical contact will be Priya Shah (CC'd). Evan will remain on the thread for product-level decisions.
- The dataset handoff window: Sep 20 is doable but tight — can we please push to Sep 28? That gives our data engineering team time to anonymize a second slice.
- For go/no-go metrics: we prefer P95 latency < 300ms and token cost per 1k < $2.50 as hard thresholds; qualitative acceptance will be a three-person review across search and chat flows.

Also flagged two risks we'd like to capture in the MAP:
1) If we need to increase context window beyond 4k tokens, there may be additional infra lead time.
2) Doc signing for the data processing addendum (DPA) — we'll have legal return that in ~1 week, request Redwood's signing priority.

If Sep 28 works, we can do a quick auth + test data exchange dry run week of Sep 29.

Evan
Evan Holt
Head of Product, ClearBay AI
evan.holt@clearbay.ai | +1 (206) 555-0284

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Holt <evan.holt@clearbay.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@clearbay.ai>
Date: 2026-09-07T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & Launch Governance — Draft schedule and responsibility roster

Thanks — looping internal owners to confirm sprint assignments and to call out a short contingency plan. + few operational notes below.

Proposed updated timeline (per ClearBay request):
- Sep 28: Data handoff (sample dataset + schema) — ClearBay action
- Sep 29–Oct 6: Integration sprint (auth, endpoint mapping, small-batch validation) — Implementation lead: Marissa
- Oct 7–Oct 21: Validation & tuning (latency/cost experiments) — Tuning lead: Mina
- Oct 22: Internal go/no-go review and customer sign-off window (Ben to coordinate bridge day)

Owner roster (for MAP doc):
- Project Sponsor: Evan Holt (ClearBay) / Jonas Weber (Redwood)
- Implementation: Marissa Cole (Redwood) — operational owner for sprints and tickets
- Runtime tuning & batching: Mina Haddad (Redwood) — KV cache/batching config and quantization recommendations
- Cutover & rollback plan: Ben Carter (Redwood) — runbook, smoke tests, rollback triggers
- Customer success enablement: Marissa (docs + runbook) & Jonas (stakeholder comms)

Contingencies we should bake into the MAP: 
1) If the DPA is delayed past Sep 24, block external dataset ingestion; run synthetic data tests instead.
2) If latency tuning cannot hit P95 < 300ms on our standard quantization profile, we'll propose a short Dedicated slot for the validation window — will provide cost delta in the MAP.

I'll update the spreadsheet and RACI and push v1.1 to the shared Drive by EOD today.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

[Forwarded inline: ClearBay_MAP_v1.xlsx — suggested row-level owners updated]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Evan Holt <evan.holt@clearbay.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@clearbay.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & Launch Governance — Draft schedule and responsibility roster

Appreciate the quick turn, team — aligning on next steps and accepting the Sep 28 data handoff. Summary and actions below (also updated in the Drive doc and attached MAP v1.1):

Agreed dates & next steps:
- Sep 28: ClearBay delivers sample dataset + signed DPA (Priya to coordinate DPA with legal).
- Sep 29–Oct 6: Integration sprint (Marissa leads) — Redwood will provide API keys and a baseline token-cost runbook prior to Sep 29.
- Oct 7–Oct 21: Validation & tuning (Mina leads) — Redwood to run three tuning passes and deliver cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Oct 22: Joint go/no-go meeting. ClearBay acceptance criteria: P95 latency < 300ms and token cost per 1k < $2.50, plus sign-off on the qualitative review.

Deliverables for next week (by Sep 14):
- Redwood: Baseline environment snapshot + integration checklist (Marissa)
- ClearBay: Primary contact confirmation and DPA status update (Priya)
- Both: Calendar invites for weekly check-ins (Jonas)

Risks & mitigations (captured in MAP v1.1):
- Longer context windows may increase memory pressure — mitigation: schedule a short performance stability test on a dedicated instance.
- DPA delay — mitigation: run synthetic-data validation path and keep the integration sprint scoped to API plumbing only.

Attachments: ClearBay_MAP_v1.1.xlsx (updated owner rows, clarified acceptance criteria), Launch_RACI_v1.pdf

Look forward to the handshake call after Sep 29 dry run. I'll send calendar invites for recurring weekly syncs (Tue 10am PT) and a pre-handoff check on Sep 25.

Thanks,
Jonas
--
Jonas Weber
Senior Director, Growth — Redwood Inference
